news.title: 创始人如何利用AI与SBA Loan收购企业
news.snippet: 一位创业者结合AI技术工具与SBA贷款融资方案，成功完成公司收购，展示技术驱动型并购的创新路径。
news.raw_snippet: # How 1 Founder Used AI and an SBA Loan to Buy a Company. # How 1 Founder Used AI and a Little-Known Loan Program to Buy a 7-Figure Company. So when I heard how Christina Salerno bought a seven-figure business in seven months, using an SBA loan and AI as her co-pilot, I wanted to understand exactly how she pulled it off. Then, in late 2025, Gesche Haas, the founder of Dreamers & Doers, the women’s entrepreneur community Christina had belonged to for more than a decade—floated an idea: she was lightly considering selling someday, and if she ever did, Christina was the person she’d want at the helm. ## How do you buy a business without the cash to buy a business? This was one of Christina’s first questions, and the answer was more accessible than she expected: the SBA 7(a) loan program, designed for exactly this situation—a profitable, cash-flow-positive business changing hands.

news.title: AI Product Management：角色、技能与最佳实践
news.snippet: 系统解析AI产品经理的核心职责、技术素养要求及AI产品生命周期管理的行业最佳实践方法论。
news.raw_snippet: # AI Product Management: Roles, Skills, and Best Practices. * The Role of an AI Product... * AI Product Manager vs ML Product... * Best Practices for Successful AI Product... It requires clear strategy, collaboration between technical and business teams, and a deep understanding of user needs. In this guide, we will explore the role of AI product managers, the skills they need, their responsibilities, and the best practices that help organizations successfully launch and scale AI driven products. AI product management is the process of planning, developing, launching, and improving products that use artificial intelligence or machine learning technologies. Unlike traditional product management, AI product management involves working with data, machine learning models, prediction accuracy, and ongoing model performance after deployment. The goal is to create products that improve user experiences and drive business outcomes. ## The Role of an AI Product Manager. An AI product manager is responsible for guiding an AI product from concept to market success.
